mapper.sql: SELECT a.*, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.name AS studentName, c.name AS className, i.category AS scoreCategory, i.dimension AS scoreDimension, i.points AS scorePoints, i.reason AS scoreReason, i.occurred_on AS scoreOccurredOn, i.status AS scoreStatus, u.real_name AS createdByName, r.real_name AS reviewedByName FROM `score_appeal` a JOIN `student` st ON st.id = a.student_id JOIN `sys_class` c ON c.id = a.class_id LEFT JOIN `score_item` i ON i.id = a.score_item_id LEFT JOIN `sys_user` u ON u.id = a.created_by LEFT JOIN `sys_user` r ON r.id = a.reviewed_by
mapper.select: ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
